excerpt_i18n.en:
At the recent AI Chongqing Smart Driving Night and AFARI brand launch event, AFARI Chairman Yin Qi expressed his views, stating that both VLA and world models are currently underdeveloped in large models and far from practical application. He confidently believes that future intelligent driving systems, whether L2, L3, or L4, will center on visual perception with large model frameworks as the underlying logic, supplemented by specialized sensors in various scenarios to ensure safety margins.

During the event, AFARI unveiled its new English brand name "AFARI" and logo, along with multiple AI strategic advancements. The name "AFARI" combines "Afar" (distant) and "I" (intelligence). Additionally, Yin Qi announced a "Triathlon" plan for Robotaxi, aiming to complete a full industry chain layout within 18 months, including large-scale deployment in 10 global cities and over a thousand Robotaxis in a single city.

Currently, L4 players like Baidu's Apollo Go, Pony.ai, and WeRide have been expanding in multiple cities for years. To close the gap quickly, Yin Qi argues that the transition from L2+ to L4 must use the same framework, as shared R&D costs and data resources are essential for a viable business model. Without a mass production foundation in L2+, advancing to L3 and L4 would be challenging.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los modelos VLA y los modelos mundiales aún no están muy desarrollados en los grandes modelos, y mucho menos se aplican. Ya sea en L2, L3 o L4, los futuros sistemas de conducción inteligente se centrarán en la percepción visual, utilizando el marco básico de los grandes modelos como lógica subyacente. En diferentes escenarios, se añadirán sensores especiales para garantizar los límites de seguridad. Tengo mucha confianza en esta evaluación técnica. Recientemente, en el evento AI Chongqing Noche de Conducción Inteligente y la conferencia de lanzamiento de la marca de Qianli Technology, Yin Qi, presidente de Qianli Technology, expresó estas opiniones. En la conferencia, Qianli Technology presentó el nuevo nombre de marca en inglés "AFARI" y su logotipo, y anunció múltiples nuevos avances en su estrategia de IA.
